import z3

# Parameters
v = 13  # points
b = 39  # blocks
r = 12
k = 4
lam = 3

# Create solver
solver = z3.Solver()

# Create matrix as list of lists of Int variables (0 or 1)
X = [[z3.Int(f'x_{i}_{j}') for j in range(b)] for i in range(v)]

# Constraints: each x_ij is 0 or 1
for i in range(v):
    for j in range(b):
        solver.add(X[i][j] >= 0)
        solver.add(X[i][j] <= 1)

# Row sums = r
for i in range(v):
    solver.add(z3.Sum(X[i]) == r)

# Column sums = k
for j in range(b):
    solver.add(z3.Sum([X[i][j] for i in range(v)]) == k)

# Inner products = lam for i < k
for i1 in range(v):
    for i2 in range(i1+1, v):
        solver.add(z3.Sum([X[i1][j] * X[i2][j] for j in range(b)]) == lam)

print("Constraints added. Solving...")
